- [ASSISTANT_SAID] TECHNIQUE No.2 THE FAMOUS PEOPLE
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Thanks to this technique, you can look for ideas in unusual environments. You are deliberately thinking “in a different context” elsewhere.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The idea is to draw upon external views that are not implicated in our situation, from people who have a fresh, naive, distant, out-of-the-box view on our issue: celebrities.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] For example, you can ask yourself what Bill Gates, Frank Sinatra or Mother Theresa would do if they had to solve our issue. It’s all about imagination.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Avoid choosing people with a direct link to your issue or your field of activity. The more people are removed from it, the more productive the technique will prove to be.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] How to go about it?
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] 1°) Write down the names of ten different celebrities, who are quite different from one another.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] E.g.,: Albert Einstein, Jennifer Lopez, Sophia Loren, Mickey Mouse, Joan of Arc, Richard Branson, Prince William, Pablo Picasso, Christopher Columbus and Nelson Mandela.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] 2°) Take the first person on your list and ask yourself what this person would do in your shoes, if confronted with your problem?
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] E.g.: What would Jennifer Lopez do in our place?
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] 3°) When no more ideas are forthcoming, do the same for the second celebrity. 
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] 4°) And so forth.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] GREAT RISK! That participants will start describing the celebrity, special characteristics, his or her work.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Instead, they need to think of concrete or imaginary solutions to their own problem, which the celebrity would have proposed, if he would have been faced with the question that is occupying us today.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] TECHNIQUE No.3 EXOTIC ANIMALS
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Much like the celebrity technique, this technique invites us to look for ideas in unusual surroundings, which are beyond our usual mental framework. Here too, the goal is to deliberately think « elsewhere ».
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Try to avoid thinking of animals such as apes, dolphins and bees.
